strings.headline: Find the connected signals through good questions, and shift the ones that don't help.
strings.signalAlt: An image of signals connecting to each other
strings.loginNote: This is a prototype, so real sign-in isn't connected yet. The ID and password fields are locked on purpose.
cautions: This is not a medical or counselling service. It does not diagnose, treat or prescribe, and it doesn't replace professional counselling or care.
The questions and hypotheses the AI offers can be wrong. If something doesn't fit, skip it or correct it.
If you're in danger, stop the chat and get help right away. Contact the emergency number for the country you're in.

What you write is sent to Google's Gemini API to produce replies. On the free tier, Google may use this content to improve its products. This page doesn't save the conversation; it disappears when you close the window.
Don't share personal details such as ID numbers, your address, passwords or bank details.
Religious and historical personas are not those people. They are guides that draw on their teachings while listening to you.
If you're a teenager, please also talk with an adult you trust or a school counsellor.
Free usage has a daily limit. Once it's reached, the chat may stop working for the rest of the day.
personas: 🪷 The Buddha (a guide inspired by his teaching)

strings.truncated: The reply was cut short because it was long.
